nodes.label: Gmail Icon SVG
nodes.description: SVG icon representing the Gmail logo. Renders a 26x26 rounded-rectangle envelope shape with the classic Gmail 'M' envelope design using Google brand colors (blue #4285F4, green #34A853, yellow #FBBC04, red #EA4335, dark red #C5221F) on a light background, with a drop shadow filter. Used as a social/auth provider icon in the platform UI.
